artifacts: Compact gzJSON trajectory with coordinate tags; compressedNPZ requested/common initial m, initial v/parameter, final parameter and actual native-m only; no intermediate vector replay claim or raw-input duplication.

common_start.bounds: Native bounds unchanged; VP bounds inverse-square-root reversed from native bounds, float64 without outward rounding; log actual bounds hashes and roundtrip caveat.
common_start.definition: requested_m from unchanged helper; (v0,common_actual_m,record)=frozen start_from_slowness(requested_m); both branches actually repeat this paid preparation. Native starts common_actual_m; VP starts v0 and must map bitwise to common_actual_m.
common_start.record: Keep requested/native-common/velocity hashes, FP difference/roundtrip flag, initial parameter/native snapshots and pair consistency. No original-m receipt reuse or hidden equivalence.

coordinate_semantics: Raw trajectories/checkpoint/final_model are m for native arm and v for VP arm. No m-only budget/quality helper is called on VP states. Only returned final VP is converted to actual m inside API timing; intermediate vectors are compact hashes, not independently replayable.
failure_policy: Full48 schedule before project input reads; attempt/progress path before work. Interrupts retain attempted row/phase/wall and all remaining unattempted rows, in-flight counters explicitly incomplete/unknown. Returned result/final parameter snapshots retained before post-return integrity/audits. Source/input/disk failure stops without auto-resume/retry or overwriting.

geometry.mapping: integer factor2: (old_coord+1)*2-1; C-order flatten on49 grid

offline_audit.definition: After API return, own m and physical velocity1/sqrt(actual_native_m) relativeL2 errors against prepared truth; fresh separately assembled IndependentCase per run rebuilds observations and evaluates common actual initial/final native m. No truth metric or audit enters policy/stopping.
offline_audit.scope: Ordinary FP/sharedNumPy-SciPy-SuperLU, not continuum truth or independent geology; scalar diagnostics for all returned snapshots retained, primary credit still gated by terminal row.

primary_credit: Only complete/cost-complete nonfailed fully returned paid final states with actual API wall<=8s AND terminal study-eligible status after integrity/offline audit qualify. No internal checkpoint quality credit and no unpaid initial fallback credit. All48 planned rows, failures/late/unreached states remain visible.
role: Prospective AI-authored provisional SOFTWARE ENGINEERING coordinate/cost comparison on already inspected development inputs

schedule.shuffle: stdlib random.Random(seed).shuffle(two methods) per case inside repetition; paired adjacent methods; fixed case order

scope: All8 are reused development slices; SEAM IDs share an ancestor and repetitions do not create independent sites. No FNO/certificate comparison, scientific confirmation, novelty, ranking10/10, student final question/design, or completion of any of four research requirements.
target_scope: Diagnostic returned-final objective ratios0.5/0.25 only, never stopping targets; event time is actual API return only when reached and jointly eligible, otherwise null, never8s imputation.

timing.anchor: Engine first clock call returns the real global start; later calls read perf_counter. Preparation is a subset, never double-added.
timing.end: Caller reads perf_counter immediately after complete API payload returns, after engine finish and final native conversion/hash/provenance/cost snapshot. Artifact compression/IO and offline audits are afterward.
timing.progress: Only bounded current-run progress writes inside timing; growing48-run status/history outside timing.
timing.reserve_policy: Fixed7.5+0.5 accounting, not a guarantee. All late API returns retained and ineligible; no reserve/budget adjustment from outcomes.
timing.shared_bootstrap: Imports/module verification reported once outside runs; cold per-run physics/oracle constructors remain timed.
timing.start: perf_counter before actual per-run source checks/input read/hash/refinement/initialization/observation preparation/common-start conversion

tolerance_scope: Same existing maxsteps200,maxcor10,ftol1e-12,gtol1e-10 and other trajectory settings; gtol is coordinate-dependent and is not an equal physical stationarity tolerance. No new target stop, prior, algorithm, parameter tuning or positive claim.
